title: Calibrated Predictive Lower Bounds on Time-to-Unsafe-Sampling in LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on the statistical methodology of survival analysis and conformal prediction applied to LLM safety (specifically toxicity and unsafe generations). While safety is an ethical dimension of AI, the paper is a technical work on a predictive metric ('time-to-unsafe-sampling') rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of religious beliefs, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical reasoning frameworks.
